<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cctype>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

static ostream& pw = cout;

int r, c;
vector<vector<long long>> bin(61, vector<long long>(61));
vector<int> countA(61, 0), countB(61, 0);
long long minDiff = LLONG_MAX;
string s;
map<long long, long long> table;

int parseInt() {
    int x = 0;
    bool minus = false;
    int b;
    bool digitsStarted = false;
    while ((b = cin.get()) != EOF) {
        if (b == '-') {
            digitsStarted = true;
            minus = true;
            continue;
        } else if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            digitsStarted = true;
            x = x * 10 + (b - '0');
        } else if (digitsStarted) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return minus ? -x : x;
}

long long parseLong() {
    long long x = 0;
    bool minus = false;
    int b;
    bool digitsStarted = false;
    while ((b = cin.get()) != EOF) {
        if (b == '-') {
            digitsStarted = true;
            minus = true;
            continue;
        } else if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            digitsStarted = true;
            x = x * 10 + (b - '0');
        } else if (digitsStarted) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return minus ? -x : x;
}

string parseString() {
    string sb;
    int b;
    bool tokenStarted = false;
    while ((b = cin.get()) != EOF) {
        if (isalnum(b) || b == '?') {
            tokenStarted = true;
            sb += (char)b;
        } else if (tokenStarted) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return sb;
}

void explore(long long left, long long right, int i, int j) {
    long long diff = llabs(left - right);
    if (minDiff <= 1 || diff - bin[i][r] * bin[j][r] >= minDiff) return;
    if (i == r - 1 && j == r - 1) {
        if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
        return;
    }
    if (i >= r) {
        long long diff1 = bin[i][r] - bin[i - 1][r];
        long long factor = bin[j][r];
        explore(left, right + diff1 * factor, i - 1, j);
    }
    if (j >= r) {
        long long diff2 = bin[j][r] - bin[j - 1][r];
        long long factor = bin[i][r];
        explore(left + diff2 * factor, right, i, j - 1);
    }
}

long long compute(long long left, long long right, int i, int j) {
    long long diff = llabs(left - right);
    if (diff - bin[i][r] * bin[j][r] > minDiff) return 0LL;
    long long key = (left << 7) | (i << 4) | j;
    auto it = table.find(key);
    if (it != table.end()) return it->second;
    if (i < r || j < r) {
        if (i >= countA[i + j] && j >= countB[i + j]) {
            int total = i + j;
            i -= countA[total];
            j -= countB[total];
            return bin[i + j][i];
        }
        return 0LL;
    }
    long long ways = 0LL;
    char ch = s[i + j - 1];
    if (ch != 'B') {
        long long diff1 = bin[i][r] - bin[i - 1][r];
        long long factor = bin[j][r];
        ways += compute(left, right + diff1 * factor, i - 1, j);
    }
    if (ch != 'A') {
        long long diff2 = bin[j][r] - bin[j - 1][r];
        long long factor = bin[i][r];
        ways += compute(left + diff2 * factor, right, i, j - 1);
    }
    table[key] = ways;
    return ways;
}

void execute() {
    r = parseInt();
    long long temp = parseLong();
    c = (temp == 0) ? (int)parseLong() : parseInt();
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (r + c); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i) bin[i][j] = 1;
            else bin[i][j] = bin[i - 1][j - 1] + bin[i - 1][j];
        }
    }
    
    long long left = 0, right = 0;
    int p = r + c, q = r + c;
    while (p >= r && q >= r) {
        if (left > right) {
            long long diff1 = bin[p][r] - bin[p - 1][r];
            long long factor = bin[q][r];
            right += diff1 * factor;
            p--;
        } else {
            long long diff2 = bin[q][r] - bin[q - 1][r];
            long long factor = bin[p][r];
            left += diff2 * factor;
            q--;
        }
    }
    minDiff = llabs(left - right);
    explore(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    s = parseString();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
        countA[i + 1] = countA[i] + (s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        countB[i + 1] = countB[i] + (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    
    long long ans = compute(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    pw << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    execute();
    return 0;
}
